Welcome to Crowhurst School
We are very proud of our school, which has a friendly, caring and supportive Christian ethos, with a highly motivated team who are committed to helping all our pupils achieve success. A distinctive feature of the school is its small size and friendly atmosphere that enables everyone, from pupils to staff, to be valued, supported and nurtured. At Crowhurst C.E. Primary School we believe that the development of a child's self-esteem is a key element to their future success, as well as an education that addresses the variety of ways pupils learn.

Sports Premium
Sport Premium Grant Funding Allocation 24-25
Sport Premium Grant Expenditure - Categories of Grant Spending 24-25
Sport Premium Grant Expenditure - Opportunities, Impacts and Sustainability Details
The government provides dedicated funding to schools to enhance the quality of PE, physical activity, and well-being. At Crowhurst, we utilise this grant to ensure our pupils lead active, healthy lives while developing a lifelong love for sport.
We are committed to delivering a high-quality PE curriculum. Every week, our classes work with Specialist Coaches to develop their skills and knowledge through a progressive series of indoor and outdoor sports. To ensure this impact is sustainable, our teachers participate in every session, using this time as professional development to refine their own coaching techniques. Additionally, we welcome Funk Fusion for a specialist dance block, further broadening the creative and physical opportunities available to our children.
